name: LayaMoE
description: Domain experts on top of the Laya decision model: one shared ModernBERT-large encoder, small expert heads fine-tuned for safety and customer-operations questions, and a router that picks one per request — typed choice / score / yes-no decisions about any text, computed in the browser in a Web Worker on the packed Q8_0 lane after a one-time 1.05 GB download.

build.description: Builds the wasm browser distribution with the Laya mixture worker
